IoitiProvider: A provider: it draws nothing of its own, only its children, under the theme, the language, the links and the motion it holds.
RouterErrorPage: In ioiti-ui/react-router, which the bundle does not hold, and it reads the error of a data router, which a card's frame has not. What it draws is ErrorState and NotFoundState, which have their cards.
RouterLeaveGuard: In ioiti-ui/react-router, which the bundle does not hold. It draws nothing until a data router (a card's frame has none) is asked to leave the page, then a dialog that takes the focus, as Dialog's card draws one.
RouterRoot: The router's root route, in ioiti-ui/react-router, which the bundle does not hold: it draws its pages and the toasts, nothing of its own, and a card's frame has no router.
